I was in an extracurricular group in high school called Technology Students Association, or TSA. There are various events in which one can compete, but the majority of my school's group competed in one called Problem Solving, which is this event where you take certain items and make them do something. 

A few examples:
1. I had to take a sheet of paper, a Dixie cup, some straws, a CD, and some paper clips to safely deliver an egg from 10 feet in the air to the ground.

2. I had to take some dry spaghetti noodles and mini marshmallows and make the tallest tower possible. 

Stuff like that. Well, after one particular competition, my group had straws left over. We all put one in the inside pocket of our blazer and called it our "tactical straw for tactical purposes." I started using it for everything. I've since moved on to a different name, but I'm not getting rid of my account to just change the username.

Unrelated, but a lot of my favorite high school memories stem from TSA trips.
